title: Protocol for evaluating mitochondrial morphology changes in response to CCCP-induced stress through open-source image processing software
protocol: Place coverslips in the wells of a 6-well dish.
Incubate coverslips with Poly-D-lysine solution for 5 minutes.
Remove Poly-D-lysine.
Wash the wells with sterile distilled water.
Keep the coverslips for drying for 2 hours.
Seed U2OS cells at about 60%-70% confluency on the coverslips.
Incubate the plate in a 5% humidified CO2 incubator for 16-24 hours.
Dilute CCCP working stock to a final concentration of 20 μM with McCoy’s 5A media.
Use DMSO as a vehicle control.
Aspirate the old media from the wells.
Add 2 mL of DMSO/CCCP containing media in each well.
Incubate for 2 hours in the incubator.
After incubation, remove the media.
Wash the wells with 2 mL 1X PBS.
Add 4% Formaldehyde solution (2 mL/well) and incubate for 15 minutes.
Wash three times with 1X PBS for 5 minutes each.
Add 2 mL PBS to each well.
Add 2 mL of permeabilization buffer to each well.
Incubate for 15 min.
Aspirate the permeabilization buffer.
Wash three times in 1X PBS for 5 min each.
Add 1 mL of Goat Serum to each well.
Incubate for 1–2 h.
After incubation, wash the coverslips once with 1X PBS.
Prepare the staining chamber by placing parafilm on top of a wet blotting paper in a closed environment.
Dilute the primary antibodies in antibody dilution buffer.
Incubate for 2 hrs.
Transfer the coverslips from the 6-well dish to the staining chamber using a fine-tip tweezer.
Incubate with 30‒40 μL primary antibody solution.
After incubation with the primary antibody, transfer the coverslips back to the 6 well dish.
Wash coverslips for 3 times with 1X PBS.
Dilute the secondary antibodies in antibody dilution buffer.
Incubate for 1 hr.
Wash coverslips for 3 times with 1X PBS.
Clean the glass slides with 70% alcohol.
Invert and mount the coverslips with Fluoromount G.
Leave it to dry overnight.
Open the image stack in Fiji.
Subtract background noise.
In the Fiji menu window, select Process > Subtract Background.
Set the rolling ball radius to 50.0 pixels.
Apply a low median filter with a radius of 1 pixel.
Binarize using default settings.
Despeckle to remove excess noise.
Manually check each image for effective binarization.
Open classifier trainer.
Create new classes: network, puncta, and background.
Select 5 networks and add them to their respective label.
Select 5 puncta and add them to their respective label.
Select 5 areas of background and add them to the label.
Train classifier with default settings.
Refine the classifier by adding more traces if needed.
Save the classifier.
Load the binarized image stack and apply the saved classifier.
Convert the classified image stack to RGB.
Duplicate the image stack.
Color threshold for each stack to keep only networks in one duplicate.
Color threshold for each stack to keep only puncta in the other duplicate.
Binarize each stack.
Quantify the total area of networks and puncta.
Select “Display results” in Analyze Particles.
Save the results.
Open the saved file in Excel.
Calculate the sum of all particles from each label.
Add labels together to get the total area of mitochondria.
Divide each labeled area by the total area to get the percentage of the total.
